profile.summary: Universus Photo Imagings Limited manufactures, trades, and sells photographic and other imaging products in India. The company also manufactures, sells, distributes, converts, and produces X-ray films; and non-tearable (NTR) films are used for photo albums, certificates, playing cards, gift cards, visiting cards, calendars, menu cards, wedding invitations, and modelling portfolio.
